dog.description_text:
Valentina is a tiny chihuahua mix who weighs just 7 lbs and is estimated to be around 1 year old. She has the sweetest little face and the kind of eyes that make you want to reassure her that everything is going to be okay.

She’s a very shy girl who is still learning that the world can be a safe place. Valentina will need a patient adopter who won’t rush her, gives her time to settle in, and is excited to help her slowly build confidence at her own pace.

Registered adopters interested in Valentina can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
